The error in pixels can be seen also in the GCP table in the dX[pixels] and dY[pixels] columns.
The error in pixels should not be higher than 10 pixels.
If it is, you should review the points you have digitized and the coordinates you have entered to find what the problem is.
set the map transparency to 50% and compare it to the aerial image.
